agent_priors_used: Local optima / diminishing returns prior: after 10+ experiments in same narrow synthetic DGP, marginal information gain drops sharply while opportunity cost of neglected central claims rises — distinguished from SPIDER evidence which only shows per-experiment PASS/FAIL but not the portfolio opportunity cost.

Long-horizon path dependence / compounding error prior: agents inherit stale mechanisms that appear semantically similar but are topologically wrong; without falsifiable commitment testing and calibrated UNKNOWN, reuse amplifies drift — used to prioritize freshness/delta-repair with false-accept/contamination measurement, not derived from Codex correlation r values.

Infrastructure-failure vs scientific-falsification prior: measurement_invalid often reflects environment ceilings (hash dispersal, per-node store, oracle-guided decode, 304 handling) misread as negatives; fixing substrate unlocks higher-information experiments — distinguished from SPIDER's frozen REJECTED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID labels.

Caching vs semantic generalization tension prior: exact replay gives 90ms 0-token economics for stable tasks (TERX/HyperAgent 23k->0 tokens, 173x speedup) but fails on novel identifiers; product economics must be amortized over repeat frequency and measured vs replay baseline, not single-run tokens — informs mandatory strong baseline, not established by WebArena-Verified v2 single-store MIXED result.

Exploration/exploitation / workflow compilation prior: program synthesis and federated memory search outside current basin can radically change architecture if validated; synthetic TV/KDE tuning is exploitation within basin — motivates Frontier orthogonal pivot, not evidenced by frontier's rho=1.0 translation signal.
